title: Constant assignment for three-variable linear constraints
statement: Let $P$ be a finite instance of the constraint problem over $\mathbb F_2$ whose predicates require the sum of three distinct variables to equal a specified right-hand side. Then one of the two constant assignments, assigning the same bit to every variable, satisfies at least half of the constraints, counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a constraint instance for the specified three-variable linear constraint template.
The instance has at least one constraint.
Every declared variable occurs in the scope of some constraint.
